product_one_liner.value: Spacelift is an infrastructure orchestration platform for DevOps, platform, and SRE teams that manages infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and governance across their infrastructure tooling.

pricing_page.notes: The company publishes a plans and pricing page.

named_customers.notes: Both are named in customer success stories.

employee_band.notes: The company profile places headcount in the 51–200 range, while the careers page says it has more than 130 employees, putting it in the requested 101–200 band.

founded_year.notes: The company profile states it was founded in 2020.

eng_blog.notes: At least two posts cover technical internals or deployment of Kubernetes workers; their authors are identified as a backend software engineer and a DevOps/Cloud engineering specialist.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal links to multiple product documentation articles and guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists current openings, and none of the listed titles is an AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.value: AWS Bedrock (Anthropic/Claude models) for Spacelift’s default hosted AI integration; customers may also configure their own provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center lists SOC 2 and GDPR under Compliance and links a PCI-DSS SAQ-A 2025 report; AWS FTR is not one of the requested categories.

raised_18mo.notes: The $51 million Series C was announced July 10, 2025, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job openings include an Enterprise Account Executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: A September 8, 2026 announcement says Spacelift Flows became available in limited release, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On May 5, 2026, Spacelift announced two senior additions to its executive team, including two senior vice presidents.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The subprocessor list names HubSpot for marketing and Salesforce for CRM.
